meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把 NanoClaw 的上游更新合并进你本地改过的版本:先检查工作区并建立备份,预览变更分类,再通过合并、cherry-pick 或变基应用更新,解决冲突后自动运行构建和测试,并提示破坏性变更。
howto.when: 在 Claude Code 里运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 时触发。它会先做预检和备份,再进行后续操作。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw,把上游更新合并进来
用 /update-nanoclaw 只挑几个提交来更新
say.note: 选 cherry-pick,只应用你选的提交
只预览不合并,可选择中止

howto.what_en: This skill pulls upstream NanoClaw changes into a customized install. It backs up, previews changes by category, merges/cherry-picks/rebases, resolves conflicts, runs build and tests, and reports breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered by running /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code. Preflight and a backup happen before any changes.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to merge in upstream changes.
say_en.note: It backs up and previews first.

say_en.text: Use /update-nanoclaw to cherry-pick a few commits.
say_en.note: Pick the commit hashes you want.

say_en.text: /update-nanoclaw, just show me the upstream changes.
